title: Wynn's records and season on the boat with Charlie Creath
summary: He recalls records with Charlie Creath and with Sam Wooding in Europe, and the riverboat season.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Preston. So Preston made the record. Are there any other records that you might be on that maybe people don't know about? Of course you don't know what people know but I mean the ones you made under your own name and say the Ma Rainey? And can you think of anything else now that people might not have heard about?

Well I made some with Charlie Creff. I mean I mean. Oh you were on them? Yeah I'm on the Charlie Creff records. And of course with the band in Europe with Sam Wooden's band we made a complete catalog of them. Oh yes all of them. We made many records. But those are all known about but. The other the Charlie Creff do you remember the who else was in the band? Was Zutty with them then? No Zutty wasn't with them then. Zutty was in Chicago then. And Dewey Washington was in Chicago. And Dewey Washington was in the band. And Horace Hewbanks was in the band. And there was a tenor player from Kansas City. I remember the name of the Waddy Walters, he was one of the twins, there was two twin brothers that played. And Lovingood, he played the Boats in New Orleans, he was a terrific pianist, he was with us all the time on the boats.
You were on the boat then one summer, one year about?
Yeah, one season, yeah. And they wanted me to go down to New Orleans to work on the capital with fate, but I was very anxious to get back to Chicago, so I didn't take that.
